      • createClientContext

        public static DbContext createClientContext(String host,
                                            int port,
                                            String mandant,
                                            String password,
                                            String appName)
        Returns a client context instance using the ContextManager default implementation and the DefaultCredentialsProvider.
        Essentially this method does the same as

        ConnectionProperties connectionProperties = new ConnectionProperties(host, port, mandant, appName); ContextHelper.buildContextManager().createClientContext(connectionProperties, new DefaultCredentialsProvider(password));
        Parameters:
        host - Host of the database server.
        port - Port of the database service on the database host.
        mandant - Name or directory of the abas client.
        appName - Is used to indicate this session in the abas user list. If appName is empty, a default value will be used.
        password - The password.
        Returns:
        A client context instance.
